evidence: Al2O3 films were deposited on p-type silicon (100) wafers at 100°C, using methylpyrrolidine alane (C5H14NAl, MPA) and capacitively coupled O2 plasma as the sources of Al and O, respectively. The wafers were cleaned with trichloroethylene, acetone, and methanol for 10 min, and were boiled in a mixture of sulfuric acid and hydrogen peroxide for 10 min. The wafers were then immersed in a 50:1 HF solution, until the surface was hydrophobic.
